title: Al Noor Mosque, Christchurch
geometryBasis: Earliest ten-vertex Deans Avenue mosque outline based on March 2008 mapping and a cleared photograph dated June 2006.
sectionBasis: Low cream precast walls, dark green linear and chevron ornament, bevelled roof drum, gold dome with crescent and slim white minaret with gold cap.
limitations: The exterior represents the 2006 building with dry surfaces. The photograph records temporary snow, which is outside the modeled architecture.
The broad gold dome, slim capped minaret and green panel motifs follow the dated photo. Their precise sizes, the west projection’s position, and the unpictured street and rear details are estimates.
The 2008-based footprint is the earliest available map control. The original terrain is unchanged and footing contact is approximate.
